description: Source code implementing Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) operations for scan, cummax, cummin, and logcumsumexp in PyTorch's ATen library, specifically for Apple M1/M2 GPU acceleration.

methods.name: get_2d_grid_dims
methods.description: Calculates 2D grid dimensions for GPU dispatch based on tensor shape and dimension.

methods.name: scan_simple_mps_impl
methods.description: Performs a simple scan operation (like cumsum, logcumsumexp) on GPU using Metal shaders, handling contiguous tensors and dispatching compute kernels.

methods.name: scan_with_indices_mps_impl
methods.description: Performs scan operations that return both values and indices (like cummax, cummin) on GPU.
